# HYPNOS-CLASS 攔截穿梭機
[color=#a4885c]船隻尺寸：[/color] 中型
[color=#a4885c]艦隊穿梭機：[/color] 無
[color=#a4885c]建議船員人數：[/color] 2-3 人
[color=#a4885c]動力生成類型：[/color] 鈾
[color=#a4885c]遠征任務：[/color] 無
[color=#a4885c]敵我識別（IFF）控制台：[/color] 有
[color=#a4885c]最低存取等級：[/color] 中士
「『希普諾斯號』是一艘輕型中型艦艇，建議配有 2 至 3 名軍官，作為專門的攔截艦，配備強大的電磁脈衝裝置，用以對付試圖逃逸的船隻。」
# Ship Functions
- 該電磁脈衝（EMP）裝置的最大作用範圍為 100 公尺。 開火前請確認您處於有效射程內。
# 運行 NSF Hypnos 穿梭機的要訣 - 發電機組的最佳 [bold]目標功率[/bold]（kW）為 [color=#a4885c]30 [bold]kW[/bold][/color]。 If you've added additional machines, check shuttle [bold]APC units[/bold] to monitor the shuttle's power draw and adjust the generator's [bold]Target Power[/bold] accordingly. For more general information on the power grid and other life support systems, refer to the [textlink="Power" link="Power"] guidebook article and the [textlink="Preflight Checklist" link="PreflightChecklist"/]. - For the basics of [bold]shuttle piloting[/bold], refer to [textlink="Piloting" link="Piloting"] and [textlink="Sector Topology" link="SectorTopology"/]. - For the basics of [bold]cargo hauling[/bold], refer to [textlink="Cargo Hauling" link="CargoHauling"]. - For the basics of [bold]expedition diving[/bold], refer to [textlink="Expeditions" link="Expeditions"]. - As a Captain of a Nanotrasen vessel, you have the authority to hire, fire, demote, or promote crew members at will, refer to [textlink="Hiring" link="Hiring"] for more information.
